description: Low-poly faceted Delaunay triangulation mesh creating geometric architectural depth.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Geometric
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Passive Polyhedral Canvas: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
